text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data sent between users and the server. This keeps passwords and personal information safe from attackers. Another important step is authentication, which confirms that users are who they claim to be. Strong passwords and two-factor authentication make accounts harder to break into. Developers must also validate all input, because unchecked data can allow dangerous attacks. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, often come from poor input handling. By following these basic rules, developers can build safer websites and protect both users and their own systems.
